## Highlights

This release adds support for the Busch-Jaeger 6257-WL radiator thermostat and removes the unmaintained `backoff` dependency.

### 6257-WL radiator thermostat support (#308)

The Busch-Jaeger 6257-WL Smart Radiator Thermostat reports `FID_PROXY_ROOM_TEMPERATURE_CONTROLLER_TYPE0` (`0x1C00`). It was previously skipped, and is now loaded as a `RadiatorActuator`, with the same states and actions as other radiator thermostats.

### `backoff` dependency removed (#309)

`backoff` called `asyncio.iscoroutinefunction`, which is deprecated in Python 3.14 and caused `DeprecationWarning`s, for example in every Home Assistant 2026.x install. Requests are now retried by a small internal loop with the same behavior: only invalid API responses are retried, up to `FREEATHOME_MAX_REQUEST_TRIES` tries (default 5), with exponential backoff and jitter.

Minor differences:

- `FREEATHOME_MAX_REQUEST_TRIES` is read on each request instead of once at import time.
- Retries are logged at info level on the `abbfreeathome.api` logger.
